ManpowerGroup Inc. (MAN) Analysts See $2.20 EPS; Ubs Oconnor Trimmed Its Baidu In (BIDU) Position Posted by Eric Painter on January 22, 2019 at 1:18 pm
Ubs Oconnor Llc decreased Baidu In (BIDU) stake by 49.67% reported in 2018Q3 SEC filing. Ubs Oconnor Llc sold 58,370 shares as Baidu In (BIDU)’s stock declined 16.10%. The Ubs Oconnor Llc holds 59,143 shares with $13.53B value, down from 117,513 last quarter. Baidu In now has $59.73B valuation. The stock increased 1.93% or $3.25 during the last trading session, reaching $171.36. About 18,600 shares traded. Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ:BIDU) has declined 23.09% since January 22, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.09% the S&P500. Analysts expect ManpowerGroup Inc. (NYSE:MAN) to report $2.20 EPS on February, 1.They anticipate $0.08 EPS change or 3.77% from last quarter’s $2.12 EPS. MAN’s profit would be $136.04 million giving it 8.46 P/E if the $2.20 EPS is correct. After having $2.47 EPS previously, ManpowerGroup Inc.’s analysts see -10.93% EPS growth. The stock increased 1.61% or $1.18 during the last trading session, reaching $74.44. About 375,324 shares traded. ManpowerGroup Inc. (NYSE:MAN) has declined 41.69% since January 22, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 41.69% the S&P500. Ubs Oconnor Llc increased Nutanix stake by 120,104 shares to 125,104 valued at $5.34 billion in 2018Q3. It also upped Alibaba (NYSE:BABA) stake by 2,591 shares and now owns 4,000 shares. Weight W (Put) (NYSE:WTW) was raised too.
Analysts await Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ:BIDU) to report earnings on February, 12. They expect $1.36 EPS, down 28.42% or $0.54 from last year’s $1.9 per share. BIDU’s profit will be $474.04 million for 31.50 P/E if the $1.36 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.29 actual EPS reported by Baidu, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -40.61% negative EPS growth.

The company was downgraded on Tuesday, January 8 by Morgan Stanley. Barclays Capital maintained Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ:BIDU) on Thursday, November 1 with “Equal-Weight” rating.
Among 6 analysts covering ManpowerGroup ( NYSE:MAN ), 4 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 67% are positive. The rating was downgraded by JP Morgan to “Neutral” on Monday, October 22. Robert W. Baird maintained it with “Outperform” rating and $97 target in Monday, October 22 report. The firm has “Outperform” rating given on Monday, July 23 by BMO Capital Markets. The stock of ManpowerGroup Inc. (NYSE:MAN) has “Underweight” rating given on Tuesday, October 2 by Barclays Capital. The rating was maintained by Argus Research with “Buy” on Monday, October 22.
ManpowerGroup Inc. provides workforce solutions and services in the Americas, Southern Europe, Northern Europe, and the Asia Pacific Middle East region. The company has market cap of $4.60 billion. The companyÂ’s recruitment service portfolio includes permanent, temporary, and contract recruitment of professionals, as well as administrative and industrial positions. It has a 8.04 P/E ratio. It also offers various assessment services; career management; training and development services; and outsourcing services related to human resources functions primarily in the areas of large-scale recruiting and workforce-intensive initiatives.
